component.name: Oni
component.summary: Bungie's Oni, preserved for today's computers

description.p: A preservation port of Oni (2001): the engine rewritten for modern systems — high resolutions, fullscreen or windowed, Wayland and X11.
It contains none of the original game. On first start it asks for your copy of Oni: Anniversary Edition (its .7z archive or folder) and converts it, which takes a few seconds.
